record.paper_title: Conferences WORDS, years 1997-2017: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Can we decide whether given a morphism, it is weakly quasiperiodic on finite (infinite) words?

evidence.quote: Can we decide whether given a morphism, it is weakly quasiperiodic on finite (infinite) words?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a finite alphabet and let $A^*$ (resp. $A^\omega$) denote the set of finite (resp. infinite) words over $A$. A finite word $q \in A^*$ is said to cover a finite or infinite word $w$ if every position of $w$ lies inside some occurrence of $q$ in $w$; equivalently, $w$ can be written as an overlapping concatenation of copies of $q$ so that each symbol of $w$ belongs to at least one such copy. A finite or infinite word $w$ is called weakly quasiperiodic if there exist infinitely many distinct finite words $q_1, q_2, \ldots \in A^*$ each of which covers $w$ (equivalently, $w$ admits infinitely many quasiperiods).

A morphism is a map $\varphi : A^* \to A^*$ satisfying $\varphi(uv) = \varphi(u)\varphi(v)$. Say that $\varphi$ is weakly quasiperiodic on finite words if for every $w \in A^*$ that is sufficiently long (or, in the strongest reading, for every $w \in A^*$), the image $\varphi(w)$ is weakly quasiperiodic. Say that $\varphi$ is weakly quasiperiodic on infinite words if, whenever $\varphi$ is prolongable on a letter $a \in A$ (i.e. $\varphi(a) = a u$ with $u \neq \varepsilon$ and $\varphi^n(a) \to \infty$), the resulting infinite fixed point $\varphi^\omega(a) \in A^\omega$ is weakly quasiperiodic.

Problem. Determine whether each of the following decision problems is decidable:
(i) Given a morphism $\varphi : A^* \to A^*$, decide whether $\varphi$ is weakly quasiperiodic on finite words.
(ii) Given a morphism $\varphi : A^* \to A^*$, decide whether $\varphi$ is weakly quasiperiodic on infinite words.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches on decidability of weak quasiperiodicity for morphisms and their fixed points return only related results on quasiperiods, automatic sequences, and Sturmian quasiperiods, but no source confirming a decision procedure for weak quasiperiodicity of a morphism on finite or infinite words. Status appears unresolved in the literature accessible by search.

status_evidence.title: Quasiperiods of Infinite Words (Staiger)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies quasiperiods of infinite words and complexity, but does not address decidability for morphisms.
status_evidence.claim: No decision procedure for weak quasiperiodicity of morphisms is given.

status_evidence.title: Quasiperiods of biinfinite Sturmian words
status_evidence.snippet: Describes the set of quasiperiods of biinfinite Sturmian words.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses Sturmian case only, not general morphisms.

status_evidence.title: The Maximal Subword Complexity of Quasiperiodic Infinite Words
status_evidence.snippet: Estimates maximal subword complexity for quasiperiodic infinite words via codes.
status_evidence.claim: Does not resolve decidability for morphisms.
